caption: Rodwell v. Baraka
citation_line: Rodwell v. Baraka, No. 2:22-cv-06427, ECF No. 131 (D.N.J. Feb. 6, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Applied the Morgan high-ranking-official doctrine to Newark Mayor Ras Baraka, barred his deposition because other sources could supply the information, but required an answer to a targeted interrogatory.
qualification_rationale: A developed application of Morgan and Buono that provides a useful counterpoint to decisions permitting mayoral depositions where first-hand involvement was better established.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive protective order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Non-dispositive deposition and protective-order ruling under the high-ranking-official doctrine.
